topic.title: Logistics / Strategic Rail Freight Interchanges / Warehousing

scope_guards: A logistics allocation is not treated as permission.
A rail connection concept is not treated as an agreed connection.
Forecast freight demand is not treated as contracted throughput.
An accepted DCO application is not treated as consent.
A made DCO is not treated as discharged requirements.
Construction is not treated as commissioned capacity.
Warehouse occupation is not treated as measured rail modal shift.
No score or promotion is written without exact consent, land, connection, construction, commissioning and operation evidence.
